succeed

speech

assistant

scientific

discovery

breakthrough

(noun). Bước đột phá

fame

(noun). tiếng tăm, danh tiếng, tên tuổi

fortune

(noun). của cải

derive

native

bark

(noun). Vỏ cây

region

(noun). vùng, miền

manufacture

(verb). Sản xuất

attempt

(verb). cố gắng, nỗ lực

available

inexpensive

inspire

scientist

(noun). nhà khoa học; người nghiên cứu khoa học

potential

(noun). Tiềm năng, triển vọng

unexpected

(adjective). không ngờ, thình lình

favour

(verb). ủng hộ, thích dùng hơn

society

(noun). xã hội

associate

(verb). liên tưởng, liên kết

extract

snail

(noun). ốc sên

costly

(adjective). đắt

afford

immediately

(adverb). ngay lập tức

dye

(noun). thuốc nhuộm

fascinating

(adjective). hấp dẫn, lôi cuốn, quyến rũ

perhaps

reaction

(noun). phản ứng

instant

(adjective). ngay lập tức

Ex: The show was an instant success.

recognition

(noun). sự công nhận

commercial

(adjective). mang tính thương mại

possibility

originally

(adverb). khởi đầu, nguyên thủy

refer to

(verb). đề cập, nhắc đến

invent

(verb). Phát minh

commonly

(adverb). thông thường, bình thường

Ex: This is one of the most commonly used methods.

consult

(verb). Tham khảo ý kiến

Ex: Have you consulted your lawyer about this?

assure

(verb). bảo đảm, quả quyết

Ex: We were assured that everything possible was being done.

receive

(verb). nhận được

Ex: We received a warm welcome from our hosts.

necessary

(adjective). cần thiết

boost

(noun). sự thúc đẩy

Ex: Winning the competition was a wonderful boost for his morale.

flatter

(verb). tôn lên vẻ đẹp

shade

(noun). sắc thái màu

Ex: Cool pastel shades are just right for summer.

disease

(noun). Căn bệnh, dịch bệnh

Ex: Smoking increases the risk of heart disease.

researcher

(noun). Nhà nghiên cứu

Ex: Researchers found there was no evidence of an increased risk of infection.

synthetic

(adjective). nhân tạo, tổng hợp

particularly

(adverb). một cách cụ thể

current

(adjective). hiện tại

malaria

(noun). bệnh sốt rét

Ex: An increasing number of malaria cases are reported each year.

curiosity

(noun). Sự tò mò

Ex: His answer did not satisfy my curiosity at all.

stumble upon

(verb). phát hiện ra

run-down

(adjective). trong tình trạng tồi tệ; đổ nát, xiêu vẹo, ọp ẹp

functional

(adjective). thuộc về chức năng

Ex: These units played a key functional role in the military operation.

laboratory

(noun). Phòng thí nghiệm

Ex: The effects of weathering can be simulated in the laboratory.

solidify

(verb). làm cho vững chắc, củng cố

Ex: The two countries signed a treaty to solidify their alliance.

immerse

(verb). đắm chìm vào, ngập vào

Ex: He immersed herself in his work.

eminent

(adjective). xuất sắc, lỗi lạc

Institution

(noun). Tổ chức, viện

Ex: Harvard University is an internationally respected institution.

enrolment

(noun). sự báo danh, sự đăng kí học

viable

(adjective). (sinh vật học) có thể phát triển và tồn tại độc lập

medical

(adjective). Liên quan đến y khoa

Ex: His medical records showed that he was unfit for work.

desirability

(noun). sự đáng ao ước, sự đáng khao khát

substitute

(noun). vật thay thế

Ex: The course teaches you the theory but there's no substitute for practical experience.

mysterious

(adjective). kỳ bí

Ex: Fate works in mysterious ways.

investigate

(verb). Điều tra

Ex: Detectives are currently investigating possible links between the murders.

Incorporate

(verb). Kết hợp, gộp chung

Ex: Many of your suggestions have been incorporated in the plan.

textile

(noun). vải dệt

Ex: She makes a big profit from selling waste material to textile companies.

excretion

(noun). sự bài tiết, sự thải ra; chất thải

Ex: Excretion is one of several activities common to both plants and animals.

outrageously

(adverb). thái quá

Ex: She said that the company had acted outrageously.

fabric

(noun). Chất liệu vải

Ex: They sell a wide variety of printed cotton fabric.

patent

(verb). nhận bằng sáng chế

Ex: An invention is not your own until it is patented.

fierce

(adjective). dữ dội, mãnh liệt

Ex: Competition from abroad became fiercer in the 1990s.

tend

(verb). có xu hướng

Ex: People tend to be happier if they are in a long-term relationship.

hue

(noun). màu sắc

Ex: Her paintings capture the subtle hues of the countryside in autumn.

fade

(verb). nhạt đi, phai đi

Ex: All colour had faded from the sky.

objection

(noun). sự phản đối, sự chống đối

Ex: I have no objection to staying here.

plentiful

(adjective). nhiều

Ex: Strawberries are plentiful in the summer.

unlimited

(adjective). không giới hạn, có số lượng cực lớn, vô vùng

Ex: You will be allowed unlimited access to the files.

outdo

(verb). vượt, làm giỏi hơn

Ex: Sometimes small firms can outdo big business when it comes to customer care.

clamour

(verb). La hét, hò hét (để bắt phải...)

Ex: People began to clamour for his resignation.

decorative

(adjective). để trang trí, để làm cảnh

Ex: The mirror is functional yet decorative.

vital

(adjective). thiết yếu, quan trọng

Ex: She had found out some information of vital importance.

stain

(verb). nhuộm; làm cho có màu

Ex: Stain the specimen before looking at it under the microscope.

invisible

(adjective). Vô hình

microbe

(noun). vi trùng, vi khuẩn

bacteria

(noun). Vi khuẩn

tuberculosis

(noun). bệnh lao

Ex: The hospital has three wards normally devoted to diseases such as tuberculosis.

cholera

(noun). bệnh dịch tả, bệnh tả

Ex: The flood victims face the danger of epidemics of cholera, dysentery, malaria and other diseases.

artificial

(adjective). Nhân tạo

Ex: artifical flowers Ex: Her skin glowed in the artificial light.

sections.title: Passage 2: The Search for Extra-Terrestrial Intelligence
sections.html:
assumption

(noun). Sự phỏng đoán, giả định

Ex: It was impossible to make assumptions about people's reactions.

underlie

(verb). làm cơ sở, làm nền tảng của

Ex: These ideas underlie much of his work.

extraterrestrial

(adjective). Ngoài trái đất, ngoài khí quyển

Ex: In those rocks may lie the best chance of finding extraterrestrial life.

discuss

(verb). thảo luận

Ex: Have you discussed the problem with anyone?

scientist

(noun). nhà khoa học; người nghiên cứu khoa học

Ex: There are scientists who say that the results of the research are flawed.

adopt

(verb). Thông qua, lựa chọn

Ex: All three teams adopted different approaches to the problem.

ignore

(verb). Bỏ qua; làm lơ

Ex: I made a suggestion but they chose to ignore it.

resemble

(verb). Tạo hình giống nhau

Ex: The plant resembles grass in appearance.

likelihood

(noun). khả năng, sự có thể đúng

Ex: Taking regular exercise reduces the likelihood of a heart attack.

limited

(adjective). bị giới hạn

Ex: We have limited choices

arise

(verb). xuất hiện

Ex: We keep them informed of any changes as they arise.

estimate

(verb). Ước lượng

Ex: The satellite will cost an estimated £400 million.

astronomical

(adjective). thuộc thiên văn học

Ex: The first known astronomical observations made by Galileo were carried out in 1604 for different reasons.

term

(noun). thuật ngữ

Ex: What is the meaning of the term ‘globalization’?

seek

(verb). tìm kiếm

Ex: Drivers are advised to seek alternative routes.

transmission

(noun). sự truyền tín hiệu

Ex: We apologize for the interruption to our transmissions this afternoon.

civilization

(noun). Nền văn minh

Ex: Some people think that nuclear war would mean the end of civilization.

require

(verb). cần, yêu cầu

Ex: These pets require a lot of care and attention.

concentrate

(verb). Tập trung

Ex: We're concentrating even harder on giving quality service this year.

detection

(noun). sự dò ra, sự tìm ra, sự khám phá, sự phát hiện

Ex: Early detection of cancers is vitally important.

scale

(noun). quy mô, tỉ lệ, phạm vi

Ex: Manufacturing is done on a small scale.

telescope

(noun). kính viễn vọng, kính thiên văn

Ex: With a good telescope, you can see craters on the moon.

monitor

(verb). GIám sát

Ex: The nurse is monitoring his heart rate and respiration.

appropriate

(adjective). Phù hợp

Ex: Is now an appropriate time to make a speech?

response

(noun). câu trả lời, phản hồi

Ex: We have asked for a meeting and we are awaiting a response.

debate

(noun). Tranh luận

Ex: Many of these points were raised during the debate on prison reform.

detect

(verb). Dò tìm, phát hiện

Ex: The tests are designed to detect the disease early.

immediately

(adverb). ngay lập tức

Ex: They immediately began arguing.

impracticality

(noun). tính không thực tế

Ex: She explained to her superiors the impracticality of such a project.

notice

(noun). lời báo trước; sự báo trước

Ex: Prices may be altered without notice.

ethical

(adjective). thuộc về đạo đức

Ex: Is it ethical to keep animals in zoos?

address

(verb). giải quyết

Ex: The policy fails to address the needs of the poor.

urgency

(noun). sự khẩn cấp

delay

(noun). sự trì hoãn

draft

(verb). phác hoạ; dự thảo

life expectancy

(noun). Tuổi thọ

(noun). đời, cả cuộc đời

several

(pronoun). một vài

frequency

(noun). Tần suất

range

(noun). phạm vi

operate

(verb). Vận hành

Ex: Solar panels can only operate in sunlight.

overcome

(verb). Vượt qua

Ex: She overcame injury to win the Olympic gold medal.

deal with

(verb). giải quyết

Ex: Not all complaints are so easily dealt with.

threat

(noun). Mối đe dọa

Ex: Many wild plants are under threat of extinction.

survival

(noun). sự sinh tồn, sự sống sót

nuclear

(adjective). thuộc hạt nhân

Ex: China and India only produce a very small percentage of their electricity from nuclear facilities.

discover

(verb). Khám phá

Ex: She recently discovered two fungi that were new to science.

conservative

(adjective). bảo thủ, cổ hủ

Ex: The southern state's inhabitants tend to be socially conservative.

cooperate

(verb). hợp tác

Ex: The two groups agreed to cooperate with each other.

joint

(adjective). chung

Ex: The two sides agreed to establish a joint working group.

various

(adjective). khác nhau, đa dạng

Ex: We talked about jobs, family, football and various other things.

attract

(verb). thu hút

Ex: This proposal has attracted a lot of interest.

criticism

(noun). chỉ trích

Ex: The plan has attracted criticism from consumer groups.

Congress

(noun). quốc hội

Ex: The Democrats will probably lose control of Congress.

receive

(verb). nhận được

Ex: We received a warm welcome from our hosts.

respond

(verb). phản hồi

Ex: She never responded to my letter.

promptly

(adverb). nhanh chóng; ngay lập tức

Ex: He deals with all the correspondence promptly and efficiently.

perhaps

(adverb). có thể, có lẽ

(verb). làm ám ảnh

(adjective). ở tư thế sẵn sàng

Ex: The economy is poised for recovery.

acronym

(noun). chữ viết tắt

intermittently

(adverb). không liên tục, từng hồi

determined

(adjective). quả quyết; kiên quyết

attempt

(noun). lần thử, nỗ lực

Ex: Ex: Attempts are being made to resolve the problem of security in schools.

primary

(adjective). chính

Ex: The primary aim of this course is to improve your spoken English.

curiosity

(noun). Sự tò mò

Ex: His answer did not satisfy my curiosity at all.

pure

(adjective). thuần túy, tinh khiết

Ex: She laughed with pure joy.

evolve

(verb). Tiến hoá

Ex: The three species evolved from a single ancestor.

foster

(verb). bồi dưỡng

Ex: The club's aim is to foster better relations within the community.

variety

(noun). Sự đa dạng

Ex: This tool can be used in a variety of ways.

sufficient

(adjective). Đủ

Ex: Is $100 sufficient for your expenses?

exist

(verb). Tồn tại

Ex: I don't think ghosts exist.

tenuous

(adjective). mong manh

Ex: The police have only found a tenuous connection between the two robberies. Ex: a tenuous hold on life

mere

(adjective). ít, nhỏ không đáng kể

Ex: It took her a mere 20 minutes to win.

optimism

(noun). Tính lạc quan

Ex: We may now look forward with optimism.

consider

(verb). xem như, coi như

Ex: Who do you consider to be responsible for the accident?

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

convincing

(adjective). thuyết phục

Ex: She sounded very convincing to me

emerge

(verb). xuất hiện

Ex: The swimmer emerged from the lake. Ex: The facts behind the scandal are sure to emerge eventually.

differ

(verb). khác, không giống

Ex: French differs from English in this respect.

radically

(adverb). tận gốc; hoàn toàn; triệt để

recognise

(verb). công nhận

Ex: They recognized the need to take the problem seriously.

fellow

(noun). bạn đồng chí

Ex: She has a very good reputation among her fellows.

(verb). quay quanh quỹ đạo

Ex: The earth takes a year to orbit the sun.

base on

(verb). dựa vào

Ex: What are you basing this theory on?

severely

(adverb). mãnh liệt, khắc nghiệt

Ex: Job opportunities are severely limited at the moment.

certainly

(adverb). chắc chắn, nhất định

Ex: Certainly, the early years are crucial to a child's development.

inconceivable

(adjective). không thể hiểu được; không thể tưởng tượng được

attenuate

(verb). làm yếu đi

Ex: The drug attenuates the effects of the virus.

traverse

(verb). băng qua, đi qua

Ex: The region is more difficult to traverse than the Alps or the Himalayas.

vast

(adjective). rộng lớn

Ex: In the vast majority of cases, this should not be a problem.

dramatically

(adverb). đầy kịch tính

Ex: Prices have increased dramatically in the last few years.

conduct

(verb). tiến hành

Ex: Police conducted a thorough search of the building.

thorough

(adjective). kỹ lưỡng

Ex: He also gained a thorough acquaintance with the French language.

considerable

(adjective). đáng kể

Ex: Damage to the building was considerable.

superior

(adjective). cao hơn, trội hơn

Ex: This model is technically superior to its competitors.

sections.html:
transfer

(verb). chuyển đổi

Ex: The patient was transferred to another hospital.

migrate

(verb). Di cư

Ex: These animals migrate annually in search of food.

prior

(adjective). trước đó

invasion

(noun). sự xâm nhập

process

(noun). quá trình

mention

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

major

(adjective). chủ yếu, quan trọng

aspect

(noun). Khía cạnh

reproduction

(noun). sự sinh sản

Ex: They are studying reproduction in shellfish.

feature

(noun). đặc tính

possess

(verb). Sở hữu

ancestor

(noun). Tổ tiên

lack

(verb). thiếu

equivalent

(noun). hiện thân, kiếp

(verb). Tạo hình giống nhau

determine

(verb). Quyết định

remains

(noun). tàn tích

wonder

(verb). tự hỏi

(noun). mảnh

(adjective). Hiển nhiên

Ex: He agreed with obvious pleasure.

(verb). ghi chép, ghi nhận

(verb). so sánh

plot

(verb). vẽ sơ đồ

Ex: We've plotted our projected costs for the coming year, and they show a big increase.

outcome

(noun). Kết quả

Ex: We are confident of a positive outcome.

represent

(verb). đại diện, biểu trưng

Ex: The artist uses doves to represent peace.

dense

(adjective). Dày đặc

Ex: The forest is quite dense at that point.

cluster

(noun). chùm, cụm

Ex: The telescope is focused on a dense cluster of stars at the edge of the galaxy

overlap

(noun). phần đè lên nhau, phần gối lên nhau

Ex: There is a considerable overlap between the two subjects.

amphibious

(adjective). lưỡng cư

Ex: Most species of frogs are amphibious.

show up

(verb). xuất hiện

Ex: The virus does not show up in blood tests.

indicate

(verb). chỉ ra, hiển thị

Ex: The survey data indicate a general satisfaction with the process.

ancient

(adjective). cổ đại

Ex: People have lived in this valley since ancient times.

creature

(noun). Sinh vật

Ex: Dogs are more social creatures than cats.

doubt

(noun). sự nghi ngờ

Ex: The article raised doubts about how effective the new drug really was.

remarkable

(adjective). đáng chú ý, đặc biệt

Ex: He adapted to the new situation with remarkable speed.

transition

(noun). Sự chuyển đổi

Ex: The company was slow to make the transition from paper to computer.

various

(adjective). khác nhau, đa dạng

Ex: We talked about jobs, family, football and various other things.

evolutionary

(adjective). tiến triển

Ex: The findings are a significant addition to evolutionary theory.

enterprising

(adjective). mạnh dạn, dám nghĩ dám làm

Ex: The business was started by a couple of enterprising young women.

individual

(noun). cá nhân

Ex: The competition is open to both teams and individuals.

parched

(adjective). khô, nẻ (do nhiệt)

Ex: It was the height of summer and the land was parched and brown.

worm

(noun). giun, sâu, trùng

Ex: It's distressing enough to find a worm in your apple but finding half of one is worse.

thoroughgoing

(adjective). tỉ mỉ; cẩn thận; hoàn toàn; triệt để

Ex: The programme has been a thoroughgoing success.

abandon

(verb). rời bỏ

Ex: Much of the land has now been abandoned in favour of more fertile areas to the south.

extreme

(adjective). vô cùng, cực độ

Ex: We are working under extreme pressure at the moment.

cease

(verb). dừng, ngừng, ngớt, thôi

Ex: The company has decided to cease all UK operations after this year

revert to

(verb). Trở lại (một tập tục, một thói quen cũ)

Ex: Try not to revert to your old eating habits.

marine

(adjective). thuộc về biển

Ex: The oil slick seriously threatens marine life around the islands.

remote

(adjective). xa xôi, hẻo lánh

Ex: The area is remote, mountainous, and roadless.

breed

(verb). sinh sản, sinh đẻ

Ex: Many animals breed only at certain times of the year.

vertebrate

(adjective). có xương sống

Ex: Mosquitoes will feed on any vertebrate blood.

respect

(noun). khía cạnh, phương diện

Ex: This has been a difficult year in many respects.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

descend

(verb). Bắt nguồn từ, xuất thân từ

Ex: He claims to be descended from a Spanish prince.

key

(adjective). chủ chốt

Ex: He was a key figure in the campaign.

date from

(verb). có từ, bắt đầu từ

Ex: This map dates from the 14th century.

appear to

(verb). dường như, có vẻ như

Ex: The couple appeared to have nothing in common.

measure

(verb). Đo lường

Ex: Blood pressure and heart rate should be measured before treatment.

approximately

(adverb). xấp xỉ

Ex: The journey took approximately seven hours.

apparently

(adverb). rõ ràng

Ex: I thought she had retired, but apparently she hasn't.

branch

(noun). Cành cây, nhánh cây

Ex: She climbed the tree and hid in the branches.

aquatic

(adjective). thuộc về nước

Ex: Waterskiing is my favorite aquatic sport.

constitute

(verb). Cấu tạo nên

Ex: Female workers constitute the majority of the labour force.

consist

(verb). bao gồm

Ex: The crowd consisted mostly of college kids and office workers.

relatively

(adjective). vừa phải, tương đối

Ex: I found the test relatively easy.

bacteria

(noun). Vi khuẩn

Ex: Food that is contaminated with bacteria may not look or smell bad.

primeval

(adjective). nguyên thủy; thái cổ; ban sơ

Ex: The natural, primeval clock is the sun, by whose light we see to perform our daily tasks.
